signatures: Read the indexed Dart declaration; this file does not duplicate signatures.
invariants: Measure InputDecorator.containerOf and the button Material surface, not the full helper/error box.
Single-line height = window base + max(0, scaledFont/fontSize - 1) * lineHeight.
Helpers, errors, counters, multiline content and long action labels keep natural height.
Use bounded local width for grids/split views and bounded height for collection pages.
Never disable text scaling, shrink text with FittedBox or set finite outer field heights to pass tests.
Native callbacks, keys, focus and controller ownership are preserved; consumers own business behavior.
UiStatCard.adaptive chooses horizontal on compact windows or locally narrow/scaled panels; explicit constructor remains stable.
UiControls.select expands by default and menu itemHeight is natural; explicit isExpanded:false is a caller opt-out.
No logos, fonts, API, auth, persistence or business data are supplied by the runtime package.
Appearance precedence: per-widget overrides > explicit base theme > policy defaults. Apply policies to the original base theme, not to a previously applied result.
Underline and borderless floating labels reserve natural internal space; never clip them to force the outline height.

decision_rules.form: UiFormFields for vertical groups; UiFormGrid for bounded two-column fields; UiFormSection for titled groups.
decision_rules.list: UiCollectionPage + UiSearchField + UiCollectionList.builder. Keep data fetching/filtering in consumer.
decision_rules.statistic: UiStatCard.adaptive for auto; UiStatCard(compact: bool) for explicit; UiMetricCard for horizontal/trend use.
decision_rules.modal_notice: showUiFullscreenDialog builder context for SnackBar; UiNoticeHost via MaterialApp.builder for above-route notices.
decision_rules.styling: Consumer ColorScheme/font/UiSemanticColors; UiThemeData controls geometry; UiBorderTheme fills missing field borders; UiSurfaceStyle configures panels. Explicit native overrides win. Do not override dimensions per action.
decision_rules.inverse_surface: UiSurface.inverse + inner Builder for local theme reads. Rebinds explicit outer button palette; preserve native primary/tonal pairs. Do not paste partial Theme.copyWith overrides in consumers. Explicit descendant colors remain caller-owned.

limitations: No business or API end-to-end coverage
Physical device support must be checked by consumers
UiCountUpText accepts decimal dot/comma grouping; preformat or avoid animation for other notations
